subject.title: [Feature]: CLI command to list pending exec approval requests

question: Should the first CLI surface be read-only pending/list through trusted approval-runtime authority, or should it also expose resolve/respond under a newly defined CLI authority contract?
rationale: Listing reveals sensitive commands while resolution changes security state; current repository behavior does not establish that a generic CLI identity should receive both powers.

options.title: List First
options.body: Ship pending/list through trusted approval-runtime authority and defer resolve/respond and watch until separately designed and proven.

options.title: Define Full Authority
options.body: Ship list and resolve together only after documenting and testing exactly which CLI identities may view and decide each approval.

options.title: Read-Only CLI
options.body: Expose CLI inspection permanently while keeping decisions in existing UI and chat approval surfaces.

recommendation.title: List First
recommendation.body: Ship pending/list through trusted approval-runtime authority and defer resolve/respond and watch until separately designed and proven.

likelyOwner.reason: Owns the current implementation candidate and can align its scope with the selected authority contract.
